title: 爱情与关系
visual: spatial intimacy, meaningful objects, soft but motivated light, and clear changes in physical distance
performance: held eye contact, avoidance, hesitation, suppressed smiles, and decisions visible before words
camera: use over-shoulder, closeup, reaction, hands, and shared two-shots as relationship state changes
audio: native breath, room or street ambience, gentle score only where emotionally earned
avoid: constant dreamy slow motion, forced embraces, generic longing stares, ornamental final poses
